chunks: Dharih ibn Yazid al-Muharibi narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
The world is an excellent aid for the Hereafter.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdullah, a title of Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الدُّنْيَا: the worldly life, understood as the present earthly realm
key_terms.الْآخِرَةِ: the Hereafter, the eternal life after death
key_terms.ذَرِيحُ: Dharih, the narrator transmitting this hadith

ai.seo_question: How can the worldly life help a believer attain success in the Hereafter?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that worldly life and its lawful means can serve as a valuable support for success in the Hereafter. It presents the dunya not as an end in itself, but as a means through which one prepares for eternal felicity.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.3567 - Dharih ibn Yazid al-Muharibi narrated from Abu Abdullah (as):
"The world is an excellent aid for the Hereafter."
